title: Impact record (blast-radius obligations derived from one unit's file footprint)
description: The units/<UID>/impact.json artifact, written by the blast-radius scanner from the unit's footprint.json and carrying a .sha256 sidecar in `shasum -a 256` format. `symbols[]` are the changed definitions the scanner extracted from the footprint's changed paths; `obligations[]` are what those changes put at risk: a `reference` obligation names symbols whose other uses (referencing_paths) must be shown exercised, unaffected, owned by another unit or broken; a `coupling` obligation names the configured coupling rule (rule_id) a changed path triggered. Every obligation is adjudicated by a row of the aggregated verify.json `blast_audit`, which cites this file's sha256. hit_count is the full hit count; sample_hits[] is the capped excerpt; truncated_hits counts hits omitted by the caps, so truncation is visible rather than silent. Closed objects throughout; the scanner, not the executor, writes this file.

footprint_sha256.description: sha256 of the units/<UID>/footprint.json this record was derived from (equals its .sha256 sidecar).

kind.description: Extractor-defined symbol kind, e.g. function, class, cli-flag, schema-key.

change.description: How the symbol changed, e.g. added, removed, modified, renamed.

source_path.description: Repository-relative path whose change produced the symbol.

symbol_ids.description: ids from symbols[]; at least one on a reference obligation.

rule_id.description: The blast-config coupling_rules[].id that raised a coupling obligation; null on a reference obligation.

allOf.description: A reference obligation names at least one changed symbol.
A coupling obligation names the rule that raised it.

truncated_hits.description: Number of hits found but omitted from sample_hits[] by the caps (0 = nothing truncated).

caps.description: The scanner limits in force for this record, cap name -> non-negative integer (e.g. max_obligations, max_sample_hits). Cap names are scanner-defined, so names are open while every value must be a non-negative integer.
